story_title: Windows Print Spooler remote code execution CVE-2021-1675 listed in the KEV catalog

provenance.note: Live end-to-end holdout v3 candidate. KEV membership verified against the live CISA catalog feed (Microsoft Windows Print Spooler, dateAdded 2021-11-03).
